title: Expectation under uniform extended coordinate noise
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with at least two elements, and let $\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $-1/(|\Omega|-1)\le\rho\le1$. For any $x\in\Omega$ and any function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, the expectation of $f$ under the probability distribution that assigns mass $\frac{1+(|\Omega|-1)\rho}{|\Omega|}$ to $x$ and mass $\frac{1-\rho}{|\Omega|}$ to each other point is $\rho f(x)+(1-\rho)\frac{1}{|\Omega|}\sum_{y\in\Omega}f(y)$.
